scripts.icon: node scripts/generate_icon.js && rsrc -arch amd64 -ico icon.ico -o rsrc_windows_amd64.syso && rsrc -arch arm64 -ico icon.ico -o rsrc_windows_arm64.syso
scripts.build:win:amd64: cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o bin/windows_amd64/file-lite-go.exe .
scripts.build:win:arm64: cross-env GOOS=windows GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o bin/windows_arm64/file-lite-go.exe .
scripts.build:linux:amd64: cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o bin/linux_amd64/file-lite-go .
scripts.build:linux:arm64: cross-env GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o bin/linux_arm64/file-lite-go .
scripts.build:mac:amd64: cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=amd64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o bin/mac_amd64/file-lite-go .
scripts.build:mac:arm64: cross-env GOOS=darwin GOARCH=arm64 CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -ldflags="-s -w" -trimpath -o bin/mac_arm64/file-lite-go .
scripts.build:all:amd64: bun run build:win:amd64 && bun run build:linux:amd64 && bun run build:mac:amd64
scripts.build:all:arm64: bun run build:win:arm64 && bun run build:linux:arm64 && bun run build:mac:arm64
scripts.build:all: bun run build:all:amd64 && bun run build:all:arm64
